emma_newhire: hi folks! first week here — quick docs q: where do I put my personal ramp checklist vs anything that should be 'official' in Notion? also how do I get edit access to the team onboarding template?
paul_devex: welcome Emma :tada: Personal ramp stuff -> Notion 'My Pages' or create a private page under Team Docs > Onboarding > Private Ramps. Anything intended for the team goes in Team Docs > Product > Onboarding and needs a docs-review. For template edits, ping @rachel_docs.
rachel_docs: @emma_newhire I can grant edit on the editable template. Which one: "Engineer Ramp (editable)" or the locked canonical template? We keep the canonical locked to avoid drift.
emma_newhire: editable one please. Also, any naming suggestions so my manager can find my notes?
sam_manager: prefer titles like "Ramp — Emma K (ENG)" and include properties: Owner, Week, Status. Tag with #ramp. If you want me to read weekly, share the page with me.
rachel_docs: invited you to the Team Docs editor group. Notion/SAML sync may take a few minutes. Template link: https://notion.so/r/eng-ramp-editable-template
notion_sync_bot: System: SCIM update queued. Invitation sent to emma_newhire@redwood.com.
emma_newhire: got the invite and template, thank you! one last q: if I accidentally create a public page, how do I move it into Team Docs for review?
paul_devex: open the page menu > Move to > Team Docs > Product > Onboarding, then file a docs-review PR using the docs-review template. Ping @rachel_docs for quick review.
emma_newhire: perfect, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
